manifest.title: Trump’s Attacks on the Media Are Self-Defeating
manifest.summaryEvidence: Donald Trump is presiding over a failing presidency and lashing out at the news media—most recently by banning CNN, Politico , and MS NOW from the White House. There might seem to be a connection between these two things, but the causal link is not that Trump is punishing the press because he is failing ; rather, it’s the opposite. His inability to govern is in part a consequence of his hatred for the news media. Trump has been bullying and manipulating the news media since before he entered politics. And though it may be tempting to believe that his efforts to strangle independent reporting result from his current political travails, he has been pursuing that project throughout his current term. Trump attempted to ban the Associated Press from the White House during his first days in office, when his popularity was at its short-lived apogee. Trump’s most dangerous moves against the media came in the wake of Charlie Kirk’s assassination, when some conservatives perceived that the tragedy handed them a window to discredit their critics. In fair weather and foul, Trump simply cannot tolerate critical news coverage. His belief that the mainstream news media is profoundly biased against him and his party is an article of faith on the political right, although he has pushed much further in response to that belief than any of his predecessors ever dared.
